heading: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Find quick answers to common questions about Job Support.

jobSeeker.answer1: Yes, registration and use of the service are completely free of charge.
jobSeeker.question2: Can I register even if I don’t speak much Japanese?
jobSeeker.answer2: Yes. We introduce job opportunities based on your Japanese language level.
jobSeeker.question3: Can I register without a resume?
jobSeeker.answer3: Yes. We can create a resume based on the information you provide during registration.
jobSeeker.question4: What kinds of jobs are available?
jobSeeker.answer4: We offer a variety of jobs, including positions in food service, agriculture, construction, nursing care, and more.
jobSeeker.question5: Can I change jobs with my current visa?
jobSeeker.answer5: Yes, as long as it is within the scope of your current residence status.
jobSeeker.question6: Can you support me with a visa change?
jobSeeker.answer6: Yes. We will provide guidance in cooperation with supervisory organizations and registered support organizations.
jobSeeker.answer7: Yes. All registered companies are verified and reviewed before their job listings are published.
jobSeeker.answer8: Our management team will contact you after your application.
jobSeeker.answer10: Yes. Your personal information is properly managed and will not be provided to third parties without your consent.

employer.question1: Can we use the service even if it is our first time hiring foreign workers?
employer.answer1: Yes, you can use our service even if you are hiring foreign workers for the first time.
employer.question2: What types of residence statuses are eligible?
employer.answer2: We mainly support Specified Skilled Worker (SSW) visa holders, as well as foreign workers who are eligible to work within the scope of their residence status.
employer.question3: Can we collaborate with supervisory organizations or registered support organizations?
employer.answer3: Yes. We can assist with building a support system and consulting on partnerships with relevant organizations.
employer.question4: What is the process for posting a job listing?
employer.answer4: After company registration, you enter the job details → our team reviews the content → the job posting goes live.
employer.answer5: Job posting is completely free of charge.
employer.answer6: Interviews can be arranged according to your preference, including in-person or online formats.
employer.answer7: Yes. We handle all information securely under an appropriate management system.
employer.answer8: We mainly support industries under the Specified Skilled Worker categories, such as food service, agriculture, construction, nursing care, and more.
employer.question9: How can we check applicant information?
employer.answer9: Our management team will share application status and resume information with your company.

supervisory.forSupervisory: For Supervisory Organizations / Registered Support Organizations
supervisory.question1: Can supervisory organizations and registered support organizations register on the platform?
supervisory.answer1: Yes. You can register your organization’s information and set the job categories, nationalities, and regions you are able to support.
supervisory.question2: Can we register the job categories, nationalities, and regions we can support?
supervisory.answer2: Yes. You can select multiple job categories, nationalities, and regions that your organization can handle.
supervisory.question3: How are communications with job seekers and host companies handled?
supervisory.answer3: After an application is submitted, our management team will generally act as an intermediary to support communication and schedule coordination.
supervisory.question4: Can we register if we have multiple branches?
supervisory.answer4: Yes, registration is possible even if your organization has multiple branches.
supervisory.question5: Can we update our registration information?
supervisory.answer5: Yes. You can edit your information at any time from your My Page.
